milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple carpet is at spawn-relative (5-9, 0, 4-5), center approximately (7, 0, 5). Player spawns at (7, 1, 0) which is ~5 blocks away. Using max_distance=3 requires the player to actually enter the building through the doorway at z=3 and be inside near the carpet. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking down toward the carpet to have 'found' it.

Uses inventory_has because mining white stained glass with a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe drops the white_stained_glass block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no white_stained_glass in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting orange stained glass (8 glass + 1 orange dye at crafting table) results in orange_stained_glass items appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with none, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. The chest in the scene provides the required 8 glass + 4 orange dye.
